A single quarter-sawn oak plank, tapered legs, no hardware. The Monolith Bench is an exercise in restraint — every line earned, every joint hand-cut. Dimensions L 180 × W 36 × H 44 cm Finish Raw / Unfinished Lead time 8 Weeks From $1,480 
See the piece 
We've spent years learning three timbers 
European Oak 
Quiet · structural 
A single grade of slow-grown oak from managed forests in southern Sweden. Quarter-sawn for stability. 
Curved Ash 
Resilient · sprung 
A small reserve from the south coast, steam-bent over custom forms. Used only where the curve earns it. 
American Walnut 
Warm · figured 
Bought in single planks from a family mill in Pennsylvania. The grain decides the piece, not the reverse.
